notes: The engine already reads the discriminant: the refusal keys on `FastForwardRefusedError.tipSha` and the fate drops it (`src/mergeSpan.ts`). Both legs then row `tip-moved` and set the tick fact whose own doc names two producers, neither of them this one. No prior-attempt record is written at this refusal, so nothing there misreports. `mergeOutcomes` parses as an array alone, so a new fate breaks no resident reader.
